content.text: Name each of these things visible in the image with one short noun phrase: cup, block, marker. Skip a kind that is not visible. A first attempt gave: block: 'blue cube'; marker: 'red cylinder'; cup: 'gray cube'. These did not match exactly one object: 'red cylinder' (marker) matched 0 objects; 'gray cube' (cup) matched 2 objects. Give new phrases for those kinds only.

request.instructions:
You name objects in an image so that a segmentation model can find them.
The segmentation model matches short concrete noun phrases: colour plus
shape works best ("blue cube", "white square box", "red cylinder"). Do not
write instructions or questions, do not use "and", commas, negation or
positions ("on the left"). Each phrase must pick out exactly one thing in the
image.

phrase.description: 2-4 word noun phrase: colour + shape, e.g. 'blue cube'

response.text: {"objects": [{"kind": "marker", "phrase": "brown cylinder", "why": "only one cylinder visible, brown distinguishes it"}, {"kind": "cup", "phrase": "tan cube", "why": "unique tan color separates from blue cube and gray tray"}]}
